float verb

on water

also floating

classical

Cato, Agr. 88

natō, natāre, natāvī, natātum

verb, first conjugation

Examples

  • sī natābit

    if it floats (Cato’s test for brine)Cato, Agr. 88

Other words

  • innatō, innatāre — float on, swim in
